summary: Iteration 6 frontend regression — all 13 requested checks pass. Mission Video section fully removed; Hero CTA renamed 'Value Pillars of NuRegen' and smooth-scrolls to #pillars (diff ~0.2px); Hero renders .nr-hero-photo fallback (no <video>) as HERO_VIDEO_URL is empty; animated .nr-hero-gradient present with animationName=nr-hero-drift, duration=16s and background-position samples differ over 3s; Who We Are crossfade shows 3 <img.nr-wwa-slide> with exactly one .is-active advancing after ~3.4s (srcs: hero_field.jpg, whoweare_farmer.jpg, sensor_paddy.jpg); 'Based in Bhubaneswar, India' still present; Gallery section rendered with id=gallery, headline 'From the field.', 3 tiles + MORE COMING SOON placeholder, grid classes grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, all images naturalWidth>0; DOM order partners → gallery → footer confirmed; hover-lift on gallery tile applies translateY (-5.82px); Nav has nav-link-gallery smooth-scrolling to #gallery, no nav-link-news / nav-link-mission; static /photos/* return 200 image/jpeg; POST /api/contact returns 200 with forward_to='info@nuregen.earth'.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx has an unused useState/useEffect for videoReady while HERO_VIDEO_URL is empty — harmless, but dead code path (fallback branch never uses videoReady).

Gallery placeholder tile uses aria-hidden but contains visible informational text 'More coming soon'; consider removing aria-hidden or moving the tile to be a real list item so screen-readers announce extendability.
seed_data_creation: One /api/contact record inserted with name='TEST_iter6' (regression check).
context_for_next_testing_agent: When asserting smooth-scroll position, use a realistic viewport height (e.g. 1080). The default 4000px test viewport prevents scrolling to targets near the bottom of the page (window.scrollY caps out below the target). All iteration-6 checks verified on 1920x1080.
